pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A child says, "I am better than others because I am unique." What is wrong with this idea? (1 mark)
   A. Nobody is unique
   B. Everyone is unique, so nobody is better because of it
   C. Uniqueness has no meaning
   D. Only rich children are unique

2. If a child is hurt by someone, whose fault is it? (1 mark)
   A. The school
   B. The child
   C. The parents
   D. The person who did wrong

3. In the reference John 3:16, what does the number 16 stand for? (1 mark)
   A. The book
   B. The page
   C. The chapter
   D. The verse

4. What does it mean to say that the Bible is inspired? (1 mark)
   A. It was written in one day
   B. The writers copied other books
   C. People invented it
   D. God guided the writers so that their message is His word

5. Which of these is a sign of real repentance? (1 mark)
   A. Making things right with those we wronged
   B. Hiding the wrong
   C. Only saying sorry with words
   D. Repeating the wrong

6. How can a child trust God when facing a challenge? (1 mark)
   A. Blame others
   B. Give up
   C. Pray, read the Bible and ask for help from trusted people
   D. Ignore the problem

7. What did Samson use to kill the lion? (1 mark)
   A. A spear
   B. A stone
   C. A sword
   D. His bare hands

8. Abram travelled from Haran to Canaan, which lies to the south-west of Haran. In which direction did he travel? (1 mark)
   A. East
   B. South-west
   C. North-east
   D. North

9. What does the name Abraham point to? (1 mark)
   A. King of Egypt
   B. Father of many nations
   C. Shepherd
   D. Wise man

10. Why is the birth of Jesus unique? (1 mark)
   A. He was conceived by the Holy Spirit
   B. He was born in a rich home
   C. He was born in a palace
   D. He was born in Egypt

11. Who would come upon Mary so that she could conceive? (1 mark)
   A. Joseph
   B. Elizabeth
   C. An angel
   D. The Holy Spirit

12. Who was John the Baptist's mother? (1 mark)
   A. Elizabeth
   B. Mary
   C. Sarah
   D. Anna

13. How did the crowd treat him at first? (1 mark)
   A. They gave him money
   B. They carried him
   C. They ignored Jesus
   D. They told him to be quiet

14. Leprosy today can be treated with: (1 mark)
   A. Charms
   B. Medicine
   C. Nothing
   D. Prayer only, without doctors

15. If someone keeps hurting you even after you forgive, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Hurt them
   B. Say nothing forever
   C. Hit back
   D. Tell a trusted adult

16. What is a harambee? (1 mark)
   A. A school game
   B. A holiday
   C. People pooling resources to help someone
   D. A kind of fruit

17. Who shared five loaves and two fish in John 6? (1 mark)
   A. A king
   B. A priest
   C. A soldier
   D. A boy

18. What did the woman do when she lost one coin? (1 mark)
   A. Waited
   B. Gave up
   C. Lit a lamp, swept the house and searched
   D. Bought another

19. What does planting trees do for God's creation? (1 mark)
   A. Harms the soil
   B. Cares for the environment
   C. Kills birds
   D. Wastes water

20. Which of these shows a good response to John 3:16? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring God
   B. Believing in Jesus and thanking God
   C. Forgetting the verse
   D. Blaming others

21. What is eternal life? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of food
   B. A long holiday
   C. Life with God that never ends
   D. Life on earth only

22. Which verse says that those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 1:37
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. John 3:16
   D. Psalm 125:1

23. If a stranger tries to grab you, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Stay silent
   B. Go with them
   C. Give them your bag
   D. Shout for help and run to a safe place

24. Who was obedient to his parents at Nazareth? (1 mark)
   A. Samson
   B. Jesus
   C. Balaam
   D. Jonah

25. What should we do with phones in church? (1 mark)
   A. Watch videos
   B. Make calls
   C. Play games
   D. Switch them off or keep them silent

26. What did Jesus overturn in the temple? (1 mark)
   A. The doors
   B. The windows
   C. The altar
   D. Tables of the money changers

27. Which action shows goodness? (1 mark)
   A. Stealing
   B. Returning extra change to a shopkeeper
   C. Lying
   D. Cheating

28. Which fruit is shown by keeping a promise? (1 mark)
   A. Faithfulness
   B. Envy
   C. Selfishness
   D. Anger

29. What is a good way to limit screen time? (1 mark)
   A. Never sleep
   B. Do your homework first and take breaks
   C. Watch all day
   D. Skip meals

30. Why should you not chat with strangers online? (1 mark)
   A. They may not be who they say they are
   B. It is free
   C. It is fun
   D. They are always kind

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Describe how Daniel made a right choice in Babylon and give two lessons a child can learn from him. (5 marks)

32. Explain Ephesians 4:26 and show how a child can apply it when a friend has hurt them. (5 marks)

33. Explain what the story of Samson teaches and what it does not teach children to do. (5 marks)

34. Explain how repentance draws a person close to Christ and how a child can repent. (5 marks)

35. Name two fruits of the Holy Spirit listed in Galatians 5:22-23. (2 marks)

36. Explain how children can help the needy at school, at home and in church. (5 marks)

37. Explain how Genesis 1:27 and Psalm 139 help a child who feels unimportant. (5 marks)

38. Describe how Jesus responded when Bartimaeus called for mercy. (3 marks)

39. Explain what the parable of the mustard seed teaches about God's kingdom. (3 marks)

40. Describe three steps for saying no to temptation. (3 marks)

41. Describe how the early church began. (4 marks)

42. Explain the steps a child can take to turn away from wrong behaviour, using Zacchaeus as an example. (5 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Everyone is unique, so nobody is better because of it
   All people are unique and special to God, so it is not a reason to boast.

2. D — The person who did wrong
   It is never the child's fault.

3. D — The verse
   In John 3:16, John is the book, 3 is the chapter, and 16 is the verse.

4. D — God guided the writers so that their message is His word
   2 Timothy 3:16 teaches that Scripture is inspired by God.

5. A — Making things right with those we wronged
   Zacchaeus showed repentance by paying back.

6. C — Pray, read the Bible and ask for help from trusted people
   Trust in God shows in prayer and seeking help.

7. D — His bare hands
   He tore it apart with his bare hands.

8. B — South-west
   Canaan is south-west of Haran, so he travelled south-west.

9. B — Father of many nations
   God said that he would be a father of many nations.

10. A — He was conceived by the Holy Spirit
   Jesus was conceived by the power of the Holy Spirit.

11. D — The Holy Spirit
   Luke 1:35 says the Holy Spirit would come on her.

12. A — Elizabeth
   Elizabeth was Zechariah's wife.

13. D — They told him to be quiet
   Many rebuked him and told him to be quiet.

14. B — Medicine
   Leprosy can be cured with medicine from health workers.

15. D — Tell a trusted adult
   Forgiveness does not mean staying in danger.

16. C — People pooling resources to help someone
   Harambee means pulling together to help.

17. D — A boy
   A boy's lunch was used to feed a large crowd.

18. C — Lit a lamp, swept the house and searched
   Luke 15:8 says she searched carefully.

19. B — Cares for the environment
   Trees give shade, fruit and homes for birds.

20. B — Believing in Jesus and thanking God
   We respond with faith and thanks.

21. C — Life with God that never ends
   Eternal life is everlasting life with God.

22. D — Psalm 125:1
   Psalm 125:1 gives this picture.

23. D — Shout for help and run to a safe place
   Shouting and running attract help.

24. B — Jesus
   Luke 2:51 says Jesus was obedient.

25. D — Switch them off or keep them silent
   Phones can disturb worship.

26. D — Tables of the money changers
   Matthew 21:12 says He overturned the tables.

27. B — Returning extra change to a shopkeeper
   Goodness is doing what is right.

28. A — Faithfulness
   Faithfulness is loyalty.

29. B — Do your homework first and take breaks
   Balance is important.

30. A — They may not be who they say they are
   People online can pretend.

SECTION B
----
31. (5 marks)
   Answer: Daniel decided not to defile himself with the king's food and politely asked for permission to eat differently. Lessons: it is good to stay faithful to God even when far from home or when no one is watching; we can stand for what is right politely and respectfully; God blesses those who stay faithful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for describing the decision, 1 for politeness or asking permission, 2 for two lessons, 1 for clear expression.

32. (5 marks)
   Answer: Ephesians 4:26 says to be angry without sinning and not to keep the anger overnight. A child should calm down, avoid hitting or insulting, talk to the friend kindly or ask an adult to help, forgive, and pray for peace before the day ends.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning of the verse, 1 for not sinning in anger, 1 for calming down, 1 for talking or forgiving, 1 for prayer or making peace quickly.

33. (5 marks)
   Answer: It teaches that God is powerful, that strength and abilities are gifts from God, and that we should trust Him and be honest with parents. It does not teach children to fight lions or dangerous animals or to do dangerous things. Children should stay away from danger and call adults.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's power, 1 for gifts from God, 1 for trust and honesty, 1 for not fighting dangerous animals, 1 for staying safe.

34. (5 marks)
   Answer: Sin separates us from God. When we are sorry and turn from wrong, God forgives and we draw near to Him. A child can admit wrong, say sorry to God and others, put things right, and decide to do better with the Spirit's help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for sin separating, 1 for forgiveness, 1 for admitting, 1 for putting right, 1 for deciding to do better.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: Any two of love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct fruit.

36. (5 marks)
   Answer: School: share a pencil or lunch, help a struggling classmate. Home: help with chores, give clothes that still fit. Church: take part in collections, visit the sick with parents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of school, home and church, and 2 marks for clear explanations.

37. (5 marks)
   Answer: Genesis 1:27 says people are made in God's image, so every person is valuable. Psalm 139 says we are fearfully and wonderfully made, so God took great care in making us. God also knows us by name. Therefore no child is unimportant, and we should respect ourselves and others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Genesis 1:27 meaning, 1 for Psalm 139 meaning, 1 for God knowing us by name, 1 for the conclusion, 1 for a clear link to the child's feelings.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus stopped and said, "Call him." He asked what he wanted, then healed him and told him that his faith had healed him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for stopping, 1 for asking, 1 for healing.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: It began small, with Jesus and a few followers, but it grows large and gives shelter to many.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for small beginning, 1 for growth, 1 for shelter or many people.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say no clearly, give a short reason, walk away, tell a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

41. (4 marks)
   Answer: The Holy Spirit came at Pentecost, Peter preached, people asked what to do, Peter told them to repent and be baptised, about three thousand believed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: Admit the wrong; be sorry and tell God; say sorry to the person hurt; put things right as Zacchaeus repaid; decide not to repeat and ask God for help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step, and a clear link to Zacchaeus.
